name: scenic-slides
description: Create or refine polished, editable PowerPoint decks with full-slide contextual backgrounds, transparent 2D icons and clear visual storytelling.

interface.shortDescription: Editable slides with scenes and transparent 2D icons
interface.longDescription: Turns an outline, rough notes or a short request into an editable PowerPoint deck. Every slide gets a generated full-slide scene, each parallel point gets a transparent 2D icon, and all text, arrows, diagrams, timelines and code stay native PowerPoint objects. Each slide is rendered and checked for layout, contrast and icon transparency before delivery.
defaultPrompt: Make a 5-slide deck from this outline with scene backgrounds and icons.
Turn these notes into a short, friendly training deck.
Polish this presentation, keeping slides 1 and 2 as they are.
